summary: Iter 175 — Verified the RA bill → client_invoices mirror fix (Client Invoices page not updating after billing). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter175_client_invoice_sync.py (7 pytest cases) and ran a Playwright UI pass on Accounts → Client Invoices as super_admin. Primary bug is FIXED: GET /api/billing/invoices returns 25 rows (16 mirrored source='ra_bill') and the UI table now renders them with invoice_no/client/taxable/gross/outstanding/status; type+status filters work (status=paid → 11 rows). Create → mirror, submit/approve → mirror status 'approved', issue-invoice → mirror, and DELETE draft → mirror removed all PASS. Two real sync gaps remain: (1) POST /api/payments-in (receivables_router) updates ra_bills paid_amount/status='paid' but never calls _sync_client_invoice, so the mirrored invoice stays 'approved' with full outstanding (reproduced in UI: RA-2026-0026 showed approved / ₹11,800 outstanding while the RA bill was fully paid); (2) PUT /api/ra-bills/{id} (edit draft amounts) does not re-sync — mirror kept gross 590 while bill became 2360. Also a formula defect: outstanding = gross_value - paid, but paid tracks net_payable (after retention/TDS), so fully-paid bills show residual outstanding (RA-2026-0010: status paid, outstanding ₹2,750) which inflates AR/Client Outstanding.

critical.issue: Records payment on ra_bills (paid_amount, status→paid) without calling _sync_client_invoice → mirrored client invoice stays status 'approved' with outstanding = full gross. This is exactly the class of bug the user reported (billing/payment not reflected on Client Invoices).
Draft/submitted bill edit recomputes totals but no _sync_client_invoice hook → mirrored invoice keeps stale gross/taxable/outstanding (observed 590 vs 2360).

minor.issue: outstanding = gross_value - paid_amount, but ra_bills.paid_amount is measured against net_payable (retention/TDS deducted). Fully-paid bills therefore keep non-zero outstanding (RA-2026-0010 paid but outstanding ₹2,750). Use net_receivable - paid, and clamp to 0 when status == paid/cancelled.

Applies receipts directly to client_invoices (incl. ra_bill-mirrored rows) without touching the source ra_bills doc; the next _sync_client_invoice call will overwrite paid_amount/outstanding/status and silently lose the receipt. Reverse-sync or block receipts on source='ra_bill' rows.
Mirrored zero-value bill RA-2026-0021 shows ₹0 taxable/gross/outstanding with status approved — data hygiene only, no API error.

action_items: Add `await _sync_client_invoice(a.ra_bill_id)` after the ra_bills.update_one loop in receivables_router.record_payment (POST /payments-in).
Add `await _sync_client_invoice(bill_id)` at the end of PUT /ra-bills/{bill_id}.
Fix outstanding formula in _sync_client_invoice: base it on net_receivable (net_payable) and force 0 for paid/cancelled bills.
Decide ownership for payments on mirrored invoices: either reverse-sync /billing/receipts into ra_bills or reject receipts where source == 'ra_bill'.
Add data-testid to the Client Invoices type/status filter selects.
critical_code_review_comments: _sync_client_invoice is hooked at 6 call sites manually — any new ra_bills mutation will silently drift (already happened in receivables_router and PUT). Centralise via a single helper that performs the update + sync.
Two write paths mutate the same money fields (ra_bills.paid_amount and client_invoices.paid_amount) with the mirror overwriting on next sync — single source of truth needed.

rca_of_the_issue: The fix mirrors ra_bills into client_invoices only at explicitly hooked mutation points inside ra_bills_router. Payment recording lives in receivables_router (POST /payments-in) and bill editing in PUT /ra-bills/{id} — neither calls _sync_client_invoice, so the mirror goes stale exactly when money moves. Additionally the mirror's outstanding uses gross_value while paid_amount is accumulated against net_payable, leaving residual outstanding on fully paid bills.
